page.overview:
Who is Gyaro?

Gyaro is a member of the Macro Pirates. He is a pop-eyed goldfish fish-man. He was also a member of the Sun Pirates, before its disbanding.

As a pop-eyed goldfish fish-man, Gyaro has beige skin and black hair in a ponytail. He has incredibly large eye sockets but incredibly small eyes. He has a long jaw with large lips and a small mouth. He wears a normal t-shirt and pants. He has his Sun Pirates tattoo on his left and right biceps.

Unlike Macro, Gyaro does not appear to be very bright, easily falling for Hatchan's offer of octopus fritters in exchange for his freedom. Also, unlike most other fish-men seen in the series, he and the rest of the Macro Pirates have no qualms about selling other fish-men and merfolk into slavery.

Like many characters in One Piece he has a distinct laugh: "Ehehehe".
